# `skillset marketplace`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Check and update curated plugin marketplaces.

## `skillset marketplace check`

Check marketplace readiness and lock state.

### Usage

```text
skillset marketplace check [name] [--json] [--root <path>]
```

### Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |

## `skillset marketplace update`

Preview and confirm resolved marketplace artifacts.

### Usage

```text
skillset marketplace update [name] [--yes] [--json] [--root <path>]
```

### Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
| `--yes` | Confirm a fully specified plan-first mutation without prompting. |

### Examples

```text
skillset marketplace update
skillset marketplace update outfitter
```
